subject: general
question: Find the value of ((3+3tan²A)cotA)/(1+cot²A)secA).
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Apply **Trigonometric Identities** directly: 1 + tan²A = sec²A and 1 + cot²A = cosec²A.

Numerator: 3(1 + tan²A)cotA = 3sec²A cotA = 3 × (1/cos²A) × (cosA/sinA) = 3/(cosA sinA).

Denominator: (1 + cot²A)secA = cosec²A secA = (1/sin²A) × (1/cosA) = 1/(sin²A cosA).

Ratio: [3/(cosA sinA)] ÷ [1/(sin²A cosA)] = [3/(cosA sinA)] × [sin²A cosA] = 3sinA.

**∴ The correct answer is 3sinA.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** Expression = [(3 + 3tan²A)cotA] / [(1 + cot²A)secA]

**Formula Used:** 1 + tan²A = sec²A; 1 + cot²A = cosec²A; secA = 1/cosA; cosecA = 1/sinA; cotA = cosA/sinA.

⇒ Expression = [3(1 + tan²A)cotA] / [(1 + cot²A)secA]

⇒ Expression = [3sec²A × cotA] / [cosec²A × secA]

⇒ Expression = [3secA × cotA] / [cosec²A]

⇒ Expression = [3 × (1/cosA) × (cosA/sinA)] / [1/sin²A]

⇒ Expression = [3/sinA] / [1/sin²A]

⇒ Expression = (3/sinA) × sin²A

⇒ Expression = 3sinA

**∴ The correct answer is 3sinA.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Pythagorean Identities

Fundamental relations: sin²θ + cos²θ = 1, 1 + tan²θ = sec²θ, and 1 + cot²θ = cosec²θ.

Reciprocal Relations

secθ = 1/cosθ, cosecθ = 1/sinθ, and cotθ = 1/tanθ.

Ratio Identities

tanθ = sinθ/cosθ and cotθ = cosθ/sinθ.</p
